# PCFC HQ

> PCFC Headquarters is the head office of Dubai's Ports, Customs and Free Zone Corporation, set in Dubai Maritime City beside Mina Rashid. It pairs a ten-storey office building with a separate multi-storey car park holding more than 700 spaces, and accommodates over 1,500 staff while handling some 300 visitors a day. The LEED Gold-rated complex also contains a museum, a library and public-facing service areas, and was inaugurated in December 2024.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Maritime City, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2024

## MENASCO Scope

The PCFC Headquarters is the new head office of Dubai's Ports, Customs and Free Zone Corporation in Dubai Maritime City, comprising a G+9+R office building and a G+6+R multi-storey car park with more than 700 parking spaces. The LEED Gold-certified complex accommodates over 1,500 employees. MENASCO executed the MEP works across Shell & Core and office fit-out, covering HVAC, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems.
